claim: Tiny devices project spatial auditory environments.
originalWording: Tiny devices project spatial auditory environments.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Singularity Is Near predictions for 2010, prediction 5, printed pp. 131–132

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Small personal audio devices create a convincing spatial auditory environment.
reference.rationale: Audio spatialization and directed-sound hardware existed by 2010, but the tiny ordinary personal implementation was incomplete. Small AirPods with dynamic head-tracked spatial audio are documented by 2021. This meets the perceptual function, not the ultrasonic projection mechanism emphasized in the explanatory discussion.

strict.criterion: Tiny ultrasound/interference-based emitters physically project localized audible sound as the explanatory mechanism describes.
strict.rationale: Spatial earbuds use conventional transducers and signal processing. They do not complete the specified physical projection mechanism.
